_comment: T66 — production overrides. NO SECRETS HERE. Connection strings, JWT keys, SMTP creds, and the seed admin password are supplied via environment variables (double-underscore form), e.g. ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection, ConnectionStrings__Redis, Jwt__PrivateKey, Jwt__PublicKey, Jwt__Issuer, Jwt__Audience, Email__Username, Email__Password, Seed__AdminPassword. See docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.

Cors._comment: Browser origins allowed to call the API (the WebGL web client at play.*). Desktop client doesn't use CORS. Add origins here or override via env Cors__AllowedOrigins__0=https://...
